archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-restage
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 now restages resolved difficulty records on several terminal paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 difficulty-rating restage flow. Check that resolved tmpdir records, not stale staged records, are written for complete, cap-hit, stall-like flush paths, and handoff paths. Confirm failures remain fail-open while still recording useful warnings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
